title: CAOTE: KV Cache Selection for LLMs via Attention Output Error-Based Token Eviction
selection_reason: CAOTE evicts cached tokens using their contribution to attention outputs, improving the accuracy of cache-reduction methods and directly targeting long-context inference memory.
